title: Pelican Sound Estero FL: What Does the $11,495 Bundled Fee Cover in 2026?
excerpt: Pelican Sound's mandatory 2026 assessment is $11,495 a year and covers 27 holes of golf, four restaurants, 14 pickleball courts, and a members-only boat ramp with Gulf access. What it doesn't cover is the neighborhood fee — or the $20,300 initiation fee first-time owners pay at closing.
